SVC=$2
        TARGETNODE=$3
        if [ $# -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Usage: $SCRIPT $1 <service_name> [<target_node>]"
            exit 1
        fi

        while (true); do
            # Make sure riak_core_node_watcher is up and running locally before trying to query it
            # to avoid ugly (but harmless) error messages
            NODEWATCHER=`"${PLATFORM_BIN_DIR}/riak" rpc erlang whereis "['riak_core_node_watcher']" || :`
            if [ x"$NODEWATCHER" = x"Node is not running!" ] || [ x"$NODEWATCHER" = x ]; then
                echo "$SVC is not up: node watcher is not running"
                sleep 3
                continue
            fi

            # Get the list of services that are available on the requested node
            # If no node is specified, get the list of services from the local node
            if [ "X$TARGETNODE" = "X" ]; then
                SERVICES=`"${PLATFORM_BIN_DIR}/riak" rpc riak_core_node_watcher services || :`
            else
                SERVICES=`"${PLATFORM_BIN_DIR}/riak" rpc riak_core_node_watcher services "['${TARGETNODE}']" || :`
            fi
            if echo "$SERVICES" | grep "[[,]$SVC[],]" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "$SVC is up"
                exit 0
            else
                echo "$SVC is not up: $SERVICES"
            fi
            sleep 3
        done

functions.name: services
functions.source:
services() ->
    gen_server:call(riak_core_node_watcher, services, infinity).

functions.name: services
functions.source:
services(Node) ->
    internal_get_services(Node).

functions.name: internal_get_services
functions.source:
internal_get_services(Node) ->
    case ets:lookup(riak_core_node_watcher, {by_node, Node}) of
        [{{by_node, Node}, Ss}] ->
            Ss;
        [] ->
            []
    end.

                echo "'attach' has been deprecated, replaced by 'daemon_attach' and will be removed in the short-term, please consult rebar3.org on why you should be"\
                     "using 'foreground' and an init tool such as 'systemd'"
                
        # Make sure a node IS running
        ping_or_exit

        if [ ! -w "$PIPE_DIR" ]
        then
            echo "failed to attach, user '$USER' does not have sufficient privileges on '$PIPE_DIR', please run node as a different user"
            exit 1
        fi

        shift
        exec "$BINDIR/to_erl" "$PIPE_DIR"

FOREGROUNDOPTIONS=""
        # .boot file typically just $REL_NAME (ie, the app name)
        # however, for debugging, sometimes start_clean.boot is useful.
        # For e.g. 'setup', one may even want to name another boot script.
        
                if [ -f "$REL_DIR/$REL_NAME.boot" ]; then
                  BOOTFILE="$REL_DIR/$REL_NAME"
                else
                  BOOTFILE="$REL_DIR/start"
                fi
                

        # if not set by user or console_clean use embedded
        CODE_LOADING_MODE="${CODE_LOADING_MODE:-embedded}"

        # Setup beam-required vars
        EMU="beam"
        PROGNAME="${0#*/}"

        export EMU
        export PROGNAME

        # Dump environment info for logging purposes
        # shellcheck disable=SC2086
        echo "Exec: $BINDIR/erlexec" $FOREGROUNDOPTIONS \
            -boot "$BOOTFILE" -mode "$CODE_LOADING_MODE" \
            -boot_var SYSTEM_LIB_DIR "$SYSTEM_LIB_DIR" \
            -config "$RELX_CONFIG_PATH" \
            -args_file "$VMARGS_PATH" \
            $EXTRA_DIST_ARGS -- "$@"
        echo "Root: $ROOTDIR"

        # Log the startup
        echo "$RELEASE_ROOT_DIR"
        if ! command -v logger > /dev/null 2>&1
        then
            echo "${REL_NAME}[$$] Starting up"
        else
            logger -t "${REL_NAME}[$$]" "Starting up"
        fi

        relx_run_hooks "$PRE_START_HOOKS"
        # Start the VM
        # The variabre FOREGROUNDOPTIONS must NOT be quoted.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2086
        exec "$BINDIR/erlexec" $FOREGROUNDOPTIONS \
            -boot "$BOOTFILE" -mode "$CODE_LOADING_MODE" \
            -boot_var SYSTEM_LIB_DIR "$SYSTEM_LIB_DIR" \
            -config "$RELX_CONFIG_PATH" \
            -args_file "$VMARGS_PATH" \
            $EXTRA_DIST_ARGS -- "$@"
        # exec will replace the current image and nothing else gets
        # executed from this point on, this explains the absence
        # of the pre start hook

    case logger:allow(info, riak_repl_console) of

                  [#{mfa =>
                         {riak_repl_console,

add_listener(Params) ->
    case logger:allow(warning, riak_repl_console) of
        true ->
            apply(logger, macro_log,
                  [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, add_listener, 1},
                     line => 48,

                         "0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_build/default/lib/r"
                         "iak_repl/src/riak_repl_console.erl"},
                   warning,
                   "DEPRECATION NOTICE: The replication protocol you ar"
                   "e currently using in this cluster has been deprecat"
                   "ed and will be unsupported and removed some time af"
                   "ter the Riak Enterprise 2.1 release. Please upgrade"
                   " to the latest replication protocol as soon as poss"
                   "ible. If you need assistance migrating contact Bash"
                   "o Client Services or follow the instructions in our"
                   " documentation ( http://docs.basho.com/riakee/lates"
                   "t/cookbooks/Multi-Data-Center-Replication-UpgradeV2"
                   "toV3/ ).",
                   []]);
        false ->
            ok
    end,
    Ring = get_ring(),

functions.name: maybe_set_ring
functions.source:
maybe_set_ring(R, R) ->
    ok;
maybe_set_ring(_R1, R2) ->
    RC = riak_repl_ring:get_repl_config(R2),
    F = fun(InRing, ReplConfig) ->
               {new_ring,
                riak_repl_ring:set_repl_config(InRing, ReplConfig)}
        end,
    RC = riak_repl_ring:get_repl_config(R2),
    {ok, _NewRing} = riak_core_ring_manager:ring_trans(F, RC),
    ok.

functions.name: add_listener_internal
functions.source:
add_listener_internal(Ring, [NodeName, IP, Port]) ->
    Listener = make_listener(NodeName, IP, Port),
    case
        lists:member(Listener#repl_listener.nodename,
                     riak_core_ring:all_members(Ring))
    of
        true ->
            case
                catch
                    rpc:call(Listener#repl_listener.nodename,
                             riak_repl_util, valid_host_ip,
                             [IP])
            of
                true ->
                    NewRing =
                        riak_repl_ring:add_listener(Ring, Listener),
                    {ok, NewRing};
                false ->
                    io:format("~p is not a valid IP address for ~p\n",
                              [IP, Listener#repl_listener.nodename]),
                    error;
                Error ->
                    io:format("Node ~p must be available to add listene"
                              "r: ~p\n",
                              [Listener#repl_listener.nodename, Error]),
                    error
            end;
        false ->
            io:format("~p is not a member of the cluster\n",
                      [Listener#repl_listener.nodename]),
            error
    end.

functions.name: make_listener
functions.source:
make_listener(NodeName, IP, Port) ->
    #repl_listener{nodename = list_to_atom(NodeName),
                   listen_addr = {IP, list_to_integer(Port)}}.

functions.source:
get_ring() ->
    {ok, Ring} = riak_core_ring_manager:get_my_ring(),
    riak_repl_ring:ensure_config(Ring).

        {ok, NewRing} ->
            case inet_parse:address(PublicIP) of
                {ok, _} ->
                    NatListener =
                        make_nat_listener(NodeName, IP, Port, PublicIP,
                                          PublicPort),
                    NewRing2 =
                        riak_repl_ring:add_nat_listener(NewRing,

                    {ok, NewRing2};

                    io:format("Invalid NAT IP address: ~p~n",
                              [IPParseError]),
                    error
            end;
        error ->
            io:format("Error adding nat address. ~n"),
            error
    end.

clusterstats([]) ->
    CMStats = cluster_mgr_stats(),
    CConnStats = riak_core_connection_mgr_stats:get_consolidated_stats(),
    Stats = CMStats ++ CConnStats,
    io:format("~p~n", [Stats]);
clusterstats([Arg]) ->
    NWords = string:words(Arg, $:),
    case NWords of
        1 ->
            ProtocolId = list_to_atom(Arg),

                riak_core_connection_mgr_stats:get_stats_by_protocol(ProtocolId),
            CMStats = cluster_mgr_stats(),

                                                                Port}),
            CMStats = cluster_mgr_stats(),
            Stats = CMStats ++ CConnStats,
            io:format("~p~n", [Stats]);

    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->

                    {ok, Clusters} ->

                        Error

              list_to_binary(riak_core_connection:symbolic_clustername())},
             {cluster_leader, riak_core_cluster_mgr:get_leader()},
             {connected_clusters, ConnectedClusters}];
        _ ->
            []
    end.

    io:format("~-20s ~-20s ~-15s [Members]~n",
              ["Connection", "Cluster Name", "<Ctrl-Pid>"]),
    io:format("~-20s ~-20s ~-15s ---------~n",

         showClusterConn(Conn) ||

        ],

functions.name: showClusterConn
functions.source:
showClusterConn({Remote, Pid}) ->
    ConnName = string_of_remote(Remote),
    PidStr = io_lib:format("~p", [Pid]),
    try riak_core_cluster_conn:status(Pid, 2) of
        {Pid, status, {ClientAddr, _Transport, Name, Members}} ->
            IPs =
                [ 
                 string_of_ipaddr(Addr) ||
                     Addr <- Members
                ],
            CAddr = choose_best_addr(Remote, ClientAddr),
            io:format("~-20s ~-20s ~-15s ~p (via ~s)~n",
                      [ConnName, Name, PidStr, IPs, CAddr]);
        {_StateName, SRemote} ->
            io:format("~-20s ~-20s ~-15s (connecting to ~p)~n",
                      [ConnName, "", PidStr, string_of_remote(SRemote)])
    catch
        'EXIT':{timeout, _} ->
            io:format("~-20s ~-20s ~-15s (status timed out)~n",
                      [ConnName, "", PidStr])
    end.

functions.name: modes
functions.source:
modes([]) ->
    CurrentModes = get_modes(),
    io:format("Current replication modes: ~p~n", [CurrentModes]),
    ok;
modes(NewModes) ->
    case logger:allow(notice, riak_repl_console) of
        true ->
            apply(logger, macro_log,
                  [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, modes, 1},
                     line => 505,
                     file =>
                         "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/riak-3.4."
                         "0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_build/default/lib/r"
                         "iak_repl/src/riak_repl_console.erl"},
                   notice,
                   "[user] " ++ "Set replication mode(s) to ~p",
                   [NewModes]]);
        false ->
            ok
    end,
    Modes =
        [ 
         list_to_atom(Mode) ||
             Mode <- NewModes
        ],
    set_modes(Modes),
    modes([]).

functions.name: set_modes
functions.source:
set_modes(Modes) ->
    Ring = get_ring(),
    NewRing = riak_repl_ring:set_modes(Ring, Modes),
    ok = maybe_set_ring(Ring, NewRing).

functions.name: maybe_set_ring
functions.source:
maybe_set_ring(R, R) ->
    ok;
maybe_set_ring(_R1, R2) ->
    RC = riak_repl_ring:get_repl_config(R2),
    F = fun(InRing, ReplConfig) ->
               {new_ring,
                riak_repl_ring:set_repl_config(InRing, ReplConfig)}
        end,
    RC = riak_repl_ring:get_repl_config(R2),
    {ok, _NewRing} = riak_core_ring_manager:ring_trans(F, RC),
    ok.

functions.name: add_nat_map
functions.source:
add_nat_map([External, Internal]) ->
    case
        {parse_ip_and_maybe_port(External, false),
         parse_ip_and_maybe_port(Internal, true)}
    of
        {{error, Reason}, _} ->
            io:format("Bad external IP ~p", [Reason]),
            error;
        {_, {error, Reason}} ->
            io:format("Bad internal IP ~p", [Reason]),
            error;
        {ExternalIP, InternalIP} ->
            case logger:allow(notice, riak_repl_console) of
                true ->
                    apply(logger, macro_log,
                          [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, add_nat_map, 1},
                             line => 592,
                             file =>
                                 "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/r"
                                 "iak-3.4.0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_bui"
                                 "ld/default/lib/riak_repl/src/riak_rep"
                                 "l_console.erl"},
                           notice,
                           "[user] "
                           ++
                           "Add a NAT map from External IP ~p to Intern"
                           "al IP ~p",
                           [ExternalIP, InternalIP]]);
                false ->
                    ok
            end,
            riak_core_ring_manager:ring_trans(fun riak_repl_ring:add_nat_map/2,
                                              {ExternalIP, InternalIP}),
            ok
    end.

pause_fullsync([]) ->
    case logger:allow(warning, riak_repl_console) of

            apply(logger, macro_log,
                  [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, pause_fullsync, 1},
                     line => 204,

                         "iak_repl/src/riak_repl_console.erl"},

                   "ed and will be unsupported and removed some time af"

functions.name: resume_fullsync
functions.source:
resume_fullsync([]) ->
    case logger:allow(warning, riak_repl_console) of
        true ->
            apply(logger, macro_log,
                  [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, resume_fullsync, 1},
                     line => 210,
                     file =>
                         "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/riak-3.4."
                         "0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_build/default/lib/r"
                         "iak_repl/src/riak_repl_console.erl"},
                   warning,
                   "DEPRECATION NOTICE: The replication protocol you ar"
                   "e currently using in this cluster has been deprecat"
                   "ed and will be unsupported and removed some time af"
                   "ter the Riak Enterprise 2.1 release. Please upgrade"
                   " to the latest replication protocol as soon as poss"
                   "ible. If you need assistance migrating contact Bash"
                   "o Client Services or follow the instructions in our"
                   " documentation ( http://docs.basho.com/riakee/lates"
                   "t/cookbooks/Multi-Data-Center-Replication-UpgradeV2"
                   "toV3/ ).",
                   []]);
        false ->
            ok
    end,
    _ = [ 
         riak_repl_tcp_server:resume_fullsync(Pid) ||
             Pid <- riak_repl_listener_sup:server_pids()
        ],
    ok.

functions.name: show_block_provider_redirect
functions.source:
show_block_provider_redirect([FromClusterId]) ->
    case
        riak_core_metadata:get({<<"replication">>,
                                <<"cluster-mapping">>},
                               FromClusterId)
    of
        undefined ->
            io:format("No mapping for ~p~n", [FromClusterId]);
        ToClusterId ->
            io:format("Cluster id ~p redirecting to cluster id ~p~n",
                      [FromClusterId, ToClusterId])
    end.

functions.name: start_fullsync
functions.source:
start_fullsync([]) ->
    case logger:allow(warning, riak_repl_console) of
        true ->
            apply(logger, macro_log,
                  [#{mfa => {riak_repl_console, start_fullsync, 1},
                     line => 192,
                     file =>
                         "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/riak-3.4."
                         "0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_build/default/lib/r"
                         "iak_repl/src/riak_repl_console.erl"},
                   warning,
                   "DEPRECATION NOTICE: The replication protocol you ar"
                   "e currently using in this cluster has been deprecat"
                   "ed and will be unsupported and removed some time af"
                   "ter the Riak Enterprise 2.1 release. Please upgrade"
                   " to the latest replication protocol as soon as poss"
                   "ible. If you need assistance migrating contact Bash"
                   "o Client Services or follow the instructions in our"
                   " documentation ( http://docs.basho.com/riakee/lates"
                   "t/cookbooks/Multi-Data-Center-Replication-UpgradeV2"
                   "toV3/ ).",
                   []]);
        false ->
            ok
    end,
    _ = [ 
         riak_repl_tcp_server:start_fullsync(Pid) ||
             Pid <- riak_repl_listener_sup:server_pids()
        ],

shift

functions.name: status
functions.source:
status([]) ->
    status2(true);
status(quiet) ->
    status2(false).

functions.name: status2
functions.source:
status2(Verbose) ->
    Config = get_config(),
    Stats1 = riak_repl_stats:get_stats(),
    RTRemotesStatus = rt_remotes_status(),
    FSRemotesStatus = fs_remotes_status(),
    PGRemotesStatus = pg_remotes_status(),
    LeaderStats = leader_stats(),
    ClientStats = client_stats(),
    ServerStats = server_stats(),
    CoordStats = coordinator_stats(),
    CoordSrvStats = coordinator_srv_stats(),
    CMgrStats = cluster_mgr_stats(),
    RTQStats = rtq_stats(),
    PGStats = riak_repl2_pg:status(),
    Most =
        RTRemotesStatus
        ++
        FSRemotesStatus
        ++
        PGRemotesStatus
        ++
        Config
        ++
        Stats1
        ++
        LeaderStats
        ++
        ClientStats
        ++
        ServerStats
        ++
        CoordStats ++ CoordSrvStats ++ CMgrStats ++ RTQStats ++ PGStats,
    SendRecvKbps = extract_rt_fs_send_recv_kbps(Most),
    All = Most ++ SendRecvKbps,
    if
        Verbose ->
            format_counter_stats(All);
        true ->
            All
    end.

functions.name: format_counter_stats
extract_rt_fs_send_recv_kbps
functions.source:
extract_rt_fs_send_recv_kbps(Most) ->
    RTSendKbps = sum_rt_send_kbps(Most),
    RTRecvKbps = sum_rt_recv_kbps(Most),
    FSSendKbps = sum_fs_send_kbps(Most),
    FSRecvKbps = sum_fs_recv_kbps(Most),
    [{realtime_send_kbps, RTSendKbps},
     {realtime_recv_kbps, RTRecvKbps},
     {fullsync_send_kbps, FSSendKbps},
     {fullsync_recv_kbps, FSRecvKbps}].

functions.name: sum_fs_recv_kbps
functions.source:
sum_fs_recv_kbps(Stats) ->
    sum_fs_kbps(Stats, recv_kbps).

functions.name: sum_fs_kbps
functions.source:
sum_fs_kbps(Stats, Direction) ->
    Coordinators = proplists:get_value(fullsync_coordinator, Stats),
    CoordFoldFun =
        fun({_SinkName, FSCoordStats}, Acc) ->
               CoordKbpsStr =
                   proplists_get([socket, Direction],
                                 FSCoordStats,
                                 "[]"),
               CoordKbps = get_first_kbsp(CoordKbpsStr),
               CoordSourceKpbs =
                   sum_fs_source_kbps(FSCoordStats, Direction),
               SinkKbps = sum_fs_sink_kbps(Stats, Direction),
               Acc + CoordKbps + CoordSourceKpbs + SinkKbps
        end,
    CoordSrvs = proplists:get_value(fullsync_coordinator_srv, Stats),
    CoordSrvsFoldFun =
        fun({_IPPort, SrvStats}, Acc) ->
               KbpsStr =
                   proplists_get([socket, Direction], SrvStats, "[]"),
               Kbps = get_first_kbsp(KbpsStr),
               Kbps + Acc
        end,
    lists:foldl(CoordFoldFun, 0, Coordinators)
    +
    lists:foldl(CoordSrvsFoldFun, 0, CoordSrvs).

functions.name: get_first_kbsp
functions.source:
get_first_kbsp(Str) ->
    case simple_parse(Str ++ ".") of
        [] ->
            0;
        [V | _] ->
            V
    end.

functions.name: simple_parse
functions.source:
simple_parse(Str) ->
    {ok, Tokens, _EoL} = erl_scan:string(Str),
    {ok, AbsForm} = erl_parse:parse_exprs(Tokens),
    {value, Value, _Bs} =
        erl_eval:exprs(AbsForm, erl_eval:new_bindings()),
    Value.

functions.name: proplists_get
functions.source:
proplists_get(Path, Props) ->
    proplists_get(Path, Props, undefined).

functions.name: proplists_get
functions.source:
proplists_get([], undefined, Default) ->
    Default;
proplists_get([], Value, _Default) ->
    Value;
proplists_get([Key], Props, Default) when is_list(Props) ->
    Value = proplists:get_value(Key, Props),
    proplists_get([], Value, Default);
proplists_get([Key | Path], Props, Default) when is_list(Props) ->
    case proplists:get_value(Key, Props) of
        undefined ->
            Default;
        too_busy ->
            case logger:allow(debug, riak_repl_console) of
                true ->
                    apply(logger, macro_log,
                          [#{mfa =>
                                 {riak_repl_console, proplists_get, 3},
                             line => 1035,
                             file =>
                                 "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/r"
                                 "iak-3.4.0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_bui"
                                 "ld/default/lib/riak_repl/src/riak_rep"
                                 "l_console.erl"},
                           debug,
                           "Something was too busy to give stats"]);
                false ->
                    ok
            end,
            Default;
        AList when is_list(AList) ->
            proplists_get(Path, AList, Default);
        Wut ->
            case logger:allow(warning, riak_repl_console) of
                true ->
                    apply(logger, macro_log,
                          [#{mfa =>
                                 {riak_repl_console, proplists_get, 3},
                             line => 1040,
                             file =>
                                 "/home/dev/tiot.jp-aports/v3.24/main/r"
                                 "iak-3.4.0.26/src/riak-riak-3.4.0/_bui"
                                 "ld/default/lib/riak_repl/src/riak_rep"
                                 "l_console.erl"},
                           warning,
                           "~p Not a list when getting stepwise key ~p:"
                           " ~p",
                           [Wut, [Key | Path], Props]]);
                false ->
                    ok
            end,
            Default
    end.

functions.name: sum_fs_sink_kbps
functions.source:
sum_fs_sink_kbps(Stats, Direction) ->
    Sinks = proplists:get_value(sinks, Stats, []),
    FoldFun =
        fun({sink_stats, SinkStats}, Acc) ->
               case
                   proplists_get([fs_connected_to, socket, Direction],
                                 SinkStats)
               of
                   undefined ->
                       Acc;
                   KbpsStr ->
                       Kbps = get_first_kbsp(KbpsStr),
                       Acc + Kbps
               end
        end,
    lists:foldl(FoldFun, 0, Sinks).

functions.name: sum_fs_source_kbps
functions.source:
sum_fs_source_kbps(CoordStats, Direction) ->
    Running = proplists:get_value(running_stats, CoordStats, []),
    FoldFun =
        fun({_Pid, Stats}, Acc) ->
               KbpsStr = proplists_get([socket, Direction], Stats, "[]"),
               Kbps = get_first_kbsp(KbpsStr),
               Acc + Kbps
        end,
    lists:foldl(FoldFun, 0, Running).

functions.name: sum_fs_send_kbps
functions.source:
sum_fs_send_kbps(Stats) ->
    sum_fs_kbps(Stats, send_kbps).

functions.name: sum_rt_recv_kbps
functions.source:
sum_rt_recv_kbps(Stats) ->
    sum_rt_kbps(Stats, recv_kbps).

functions.name: sum_rt_kbps
functions.source:
sum_rt_kbps(Stats, KbpsDirection) ->
    Sinks = proplists:get_value(sinks, Stats, []),
    Sources = proplists:get_value(sources, Stats, []),
    Kbpss =
        lists:foldl(fun({StatKind, SinkProps}, Acc) ->
                           Path1 =
                               case StatKind of
                                   sink_stats ->
                                       rt_sink_connected_to;
                                   source_stats ->
                                       rt_source_connected_to;
                                   _Else ->
                                       not_found
                               end,
                           KbpsStr =
                               proplists_get([Path1, socket,
                                              KbpsDirection],
                                             SinkProps,
                                             "[]"),
                           get_first_kbsp(KbpsStr) + Acc
                    end,
                    0,
                    Sinks ++ Sources),
    Kbpss.

functions.name: sum_rt_send_kbps
functions.source:
sum_rt_send_kbps(Stats) ->
    sum_rt_kbps(Stats, send_kbps).

functions.name: rtq_stats
functions.source:
rtq_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl2_rtq) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            [{realtime_queue_stats, riak_repl2_rtq:status()}];
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: cluster_mgr_stats
functions.source:
cluster_mgr_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            ConnectedClusters =
                case riak_core_cluster_mgr:get_known_clusters() of
                    {ok, Clusters} ->
                        [ 
                         list_to_binary(Cluster) ||
                             Cluster <- Clusters
                        ];
                    Error ->
                        Error
                end,
            [{cluster_name,
              list_to_binary(riak_core_connection:symbolic_clustername())},
             {cluster_leader, riak_core_cluster_mgr:get_leader()},
             {connected_clusters, ConnectedClusters}];
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: coordinator_srv_stats
functions.source:
coordinator_srv_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            [{fullsync_coordinator_srv,
              riak_repl2_fscoordinator_serv:status()}];
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: coordinator_stats
functions.source:
coordinator_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            [{fullsync_coordinator, riak_repl2_fscoordinator:status()}];
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: server_stats
functions.source:
server_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            RT2 =
                [ 
                 rt2_source_stats(P) ||
                     {_R, P} <- riak_repl2_rtsource_conn_sup:enabled()
                ],
            LeaderNode = riak_repl_leader:leader_node(),
            case LeaderNode of
                undefined ->
                    [{sources, RT2}];
                _ ->
                    [{server_stats,
                      rpc:call(LeaderNode, riak_repl_console,
                               server_stats_rpc, [])},
                     {sources, RT2}]
            end;
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: server_stats
functions.source:
server_stats(Pid) ->
    Timeout = app_helper:get_env(riak_repl, status_timeout, 5000),
    State =
        try
            riak_repl_tcp_server:status(Pid, Timeout)
        catch
            _:_ ->
                too_busy
        end,
    {Pid, process_info(Pid, message_queue_len), State}.

functions.name: rt2_source_stats
functions.source:
rt2_source_stats(Pid) ->
    Timeout = app_helper:get_env(riak_repl, status_timeout, 5000),
    State =
        try
            riak_repl2_rtsource_conn:status(Pid, Timeout)
        catch
            _:_ ->
                too_busy
        end,
    FormattedPid = riak_repl_util:safe_pid_to_list(Pid),
    {source_stats,
     [{pid, FormattedPid},
      process_info(Pid, message_queue_len),
      {rt_source_connected_to, State}]}.

functions.name: client_stats
functions.source:
client_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            riak_repl_console:client_stats_rpc();
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: client_stats
functions.source:
client_stats(Pid) ->
    Timeout = app_helper:get_env(riak_repl, status_timeout, 5000),
    State =
        try
            riak_repl_tcp_client:status(Pid, Timeout)
        catch
            _:_ ->
                too_busy
        end,
    {Pid, process_info(Pid, message_queue_len), State}.

functions.name: leader_stats
functions.source:
leader_stats() ->
    case whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            LeaderNode = riak_repl_leader:leader_node(),
            LocalStats =
                try
                    LocalProcInfo =
                        process_info(whereis(riak_repl_leader_gs),
                                     [message_queue_len, heap_size]),
                    [ 
                     {"local_leader_" ++ atom_to_list(K), V} ||
                         {K, V} <- LocalProcInfo
                    ]
                catch
                    _:_ ->
                        []
                end,
            RemoteStats =
                try
                    LeaderPid =
                        rpc:call(LeaderNode, erlang, whereis,
                                 [riak_repl_leader_gs]),
                    LeaderStats =
                        rpc:call(LeaderNode, erlang, process_info,
                                 [LeaderPid,
                                  [message_queue_len, total_heap_size,
                                   heap_size, stack_size, reductions,
                                   garbage_collection]]),
                    [ 
                     {"leader_" ++ atom_to_list(K), V} ||
                         {K, V} <- LeaderStats
                    ]
                catch
                    _:_ ->
                        []
                end,
            [{leader, LeaderNode}] ++ RemoteStats ++ LocalStats;
        _ ->
            []
    end.

functions.name: pg_remotes_status
functions.source:
pg_remotes_status() ->
    Ring = get_ring(),
    Enabled = string:join(riak_repl_ring:pg_enabled(Ring), ", "),
    [{proxy_get_enabled, Enabled}].

functions.name: get_ring
functions.source:
get_ring() ->
    {ok, Ring} = riak_core_ring_manager:get_my_ring(),
    riak_repl_ring:ensure_config(Ring).

functions.name: fs_remotes_status
functions.source:
fs_remotes_status() ->
    Ring = get_ring(),
    Sinks = riak_repl_ring:fs_enabled(Ring),
    RunningSinks =
        [ 
         Sink ||
             Sink <- Sinks,
             cluster_fs_running(Sink)
        ],
    [{fullsync_enabled, string:join(Sinks, ", ")},
     {fullsync_running, string:join(RunningSinks, ", ")}].

functions.name: cluster_fs_running
functions.source:
cluster_fs_running(Sink) ->
    ClusterCoord = riak_repl2_fscoordinator_sup:coord_for_cluster(Sink),
    riak_repl2_fscoordinator:is_running(ClusterCoord).

functions.name: rt_remotes_status
functions.source:
rt_remotes_status() ->
    Ring = get_ring(),
    Enabled = string:join(riak_repl_ring:rt_enabled(Ring), ", "),
    Started = string:join(riak_repl_ring:rt_started(Ring), ", "),
    [{realtime_enabled, Enabled}, {realtime_started, Started}].

functions.name: get_config
functions.source:
get_config() ->
    {ok, R} = riak_core_ring_manager:get_my_ring(),
    case riak_repl_ring:get_repl_config(R) of
        undefined ->
            [];
        Repl ->
            case dict:find(sites, Repl) of
                error ->
                    [];
                {ok, Sites} ->
                    lists:flatten([ 
                                   format_site(S) ||
                                       S <- Sites
                                  ])
            end
            ++
            case dict:find(listeners, Repl) of
                error ->
                    [];
                {ok, Listeners} ->
                    lists:flatten([ 
                                   format_listener(L) ||
                                       L <- Listeners
                                  ])
            end
            ++
            case dict:find(natlisteners, Repl) of
                error ->
                    [];
                {ok, NatListeners} ->
                    lists:flatten([ 
                                   format_nat_listener(L) ||
                                       L <- NatListeners
                                  ])
            end
    end.

functions.name: format_nat_listener
functions.source:
format_nat_listener(L) ->
    [{"natlistener_" ++ atom_to_list(L#nat_listener.nodename),
      format_ip(L#nat_listener.listen_addr)
      ++
      "->" ++ format_ip(L#nat_listener.nat_addr)}].

functions.name: format_ip
functions.source:
format_ip({Addr, Port}) ->
    lists:flatten(io_lib:format("~s:~p", [Addr, Port])).

functions.name: format_listener
functions.source:
format_listener(L) ->
    [{"listener_" ++ atom_to_list(L#repl_listener.nodename),
      format_ip(L#repl_listener.listen_addr)}].

functions.name: format_site
functions.source:
format_site(S) ->
    [{S#repl_site.name ++ "_ips", format_ips(S#repl_site.addrs)}].

functions.name: format_ips
functions.source:
format_ips(IPs) ->
    string:join([ 
                 format_ip(IP) ||
                     IP <- IPs
                ],
                ", ").

# $FreeBSD$
#
# PROVIDE: riak

# KEYWORD: shutdown

. /etc/rc.subr

command=/usr/local/lib/riak/%ERTS_PATH%/bin/beam.smp
rcvar=riak_enable
start_cmd="/usr/local/bin/riak start"

pidfile="/var/run/riak/riak.pid"

load_rc_config $name

requires: run as the Riak service user

commands.dispatch_source:
# Make sure a node IS running
        ping_or_exit

        shift

        erl_rpc "$@"
commands.help:
Usage: riak rpc [Mod [Fun [Args]]]]
Applies the specified function and returns the result.
Mod must be specified. However, start and [] are assumed
for unspecified Fun and Args, respectively. Args is to 
be in the same format as for erlang:apply/3 in ERTS.

help_sources.text:
Usage: riak rpc [Mod [Fun [Args]]]]
Applies the specified function and returns the result.
Mod must be specified. However, start and [] are assumed
for unspecified Fun and Args, respectively. Args is to

commands.dispatch_source:
shift
                START_OPTION="console"
                HEART_OPTION="daemon"
                CMD_STATUS="deprecated"
                

        ARGS="$(printf "'%s' " "$@")"

        export HEART_COMMAND="\"${RELEASE_ROOT_DIR}/bin/${REL_NAME}\" \"${HEART_OPTION}\" ${ARGS}"

        # shellcheck disable=SC2174
        test -z "$PIPE_BASE_DIR" || mkdir -m 1777 -p "$PIPE_BASE_DIR"
        mkdir -p "$PIPE_DIR"
        if [ ! -w "$PIPE_DIR" ]
        then
            echo "failed to start, user '$USER' does not have write privileges on '$PIPE_DIR', either delete it or run node as a different user"
            exit 1
        fi

        # Make sure log directory exists
        mkdir -p "$RUNNER_LOG_DIR"

        relx_run_hooks "$PRE_START_HOOKS"

        DEPRECATED_START_MESSAGE=${DEPRECATED_START_MESSAGE:-"'start' has been deprecated, replaced by 'daemon' "\
                    "and will be removed in the short-term, please consult rebar3.org on why you should be"\
                    "using 'foreground' and an init tool such as 'systemd'"}
        
        if [ "$CMD_STATUS" = "deprecated" ];
        then
            echo $DEPRECATED_START_MESSAGE
        fi

        "$BINDIR/run_erl" -daemon "$PIPE_DIR" "$RUNNER_LOG_DIR" \
                          "exec \"$RELEASE_ROOT_DIR/bin/$REL_NAME\" \"$START_OPTION\" $ARGS --relx-disable-hooks"

        # wait for node to be up before running hooks
        while ! erl_rpc erlang is_alive > /dev/null 2>&1
        do
            sleep 1
        done

        relx_run_hooks "$POST_START_HOOKS"

commands.dispatch_source:
if [ -z "$2" ]; then
            echo "Missing version argument"
            echo "Usage: $REL_NAME $1 {version}"
            exit 1
        fi

        COMMAND="$1"; shift

        # Make sure a node IS running
        ping_or_exit

        relx_run_hooks "$PRE_INSTALL_UPGRADE_HOOKS"

        exec "$BINDIR/escript" "$ROOTDIR/bin/install_upgrade.escript" \
             "$COMMAND" "{'$REL_NAME', \"$NAME_TYPE\", '$NAME', '$COOKIE'}" "$@"

        relx_run_hooks "$POST_INSTALL_UPGRADE_HOOKS"
